last_sync.summary: All three commits are CI and repository-maintenance changes: the software workflows now run on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 runners, the firmware build installs its own dependencies and uses the bundled ARM binutils, and the pull request merge adds no further changes. No firmware behavior, tune layout, flashing procedure, or builder-facing build script changed, so no documentation update is required.

decisions.rationale: The software workflows were moved from a self-hosted runner label to GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 runners, with Java 21 and build packages installed inside the job. This affects only how Capoworks CI jobs are executed; firmware behavior, artifacts for users, and local build instructions are unchanged.
evidence: build-firmware.yaml: runs-on changed from ubuntu-latest-selfhost to ubuntu-24.04 with env JOBS: '4'
build-firmware.yaml: actions/setup-java@v6.0.1 with zulu java-version 21 and an apt install step for build-essential, multilib, mtools, dosfstools, zip, xxd, rsync
build-firmware.yaml: Windows simulator toolchain installed only when env.full is true
delete-all-artifacts.yaml and set-date.yaml: runs-on changed to ubuntu-24.04

decisions.rationale: The hosted firmware build now links the bundled ARM objcopy and objdump into a temporary tools directory and adds it to the job PATH. This is CI-internal tooling setup; the documented local Core8 helper already uses the bundled ARM binutils, and no firmware, artifact, or user workflow changes.
evidence: build-firmware.yaml: new Configure ARM binutils step symlinks arm-none-eabi-objcopy and arm-none-eabi-objdump from firmware/ext/build-tools/arm-gnu-toolchain-11.3.rel1-x86_64-arm-none-eabi/bin into build/capoworks-tools
build-firmware.yaml: echo "$binutils_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH" scopes the change to the CI job

decisions.rationale: This merge integrates the two CI commits already covered above. The combined diff contains only the same workflow runner and binutils changes, with no conflict-resolution edits and no additional user-facing effect.
evidence: Merge commit parents ee8be3687 and 0c023c7d1; changed paths limited to .github/workflows/build-firmware.yaml, delete-all-artifacts.yaml and set-date.yaml
Merge message: ci: use GitHub-hosted runners for software workflows
